correctionOf.whyWrong: extractLabelEvidenceDetailed calls the ordinary selectBrandObservation, so debug.finalSelections carries the DEFAULT shape with neither filterChecks nor activeRejectionReasons. The prior claim was false and is corrected here, before any acquisition OCR.

howCompleteDiagnosticsAreObtained.step1: run the production extractor once via extractLabelEvidenceDetailed and keep its debug object
howCompleteDiagnosticsAreObtained.step2: reconstruct the exact pass set production used for its FINAL Brand selection
howCompleteDiagnosticsAreObtained.step3: call selectBrandObservationWithCompleteFilterDiagnostics over that exact pass set
howCompleteDiagnosticsAreObtained.unconditionalAllPassesProhibitedWhy: Production retains the PRIMARY selection when primary Brand is OBSERVED, and only otherwise selects over the complete pass array. Calling the diagnostic selector over all passes unconditionally would produce a different candidate population from production on every OBSERVED case.

mirrorsProductionBecause.productionCode: primaryBrand = selectBrandObservation([primaryPass]); ... brand = primaryBrand.observation.state === "OBSERVED" ? primaryBrand : selectBrandObservation(passes);

parityAssertion.when: for every case, before any evidence is emitted
parityAssertion.rule: diagnosticSelection must be behaviourally identical to debug.finalSelections.brand after removing ONLY filterChecks and activeRejectionReasons
parityAssertion.authority: debug.finalSelections.brand — the default final selection remains the authority against which parity is tested; the diagnostic selection is never treated as the authority
parityAssertion.onHalt: no evidence is emitted for that case and the run stops; no case is retried and no mismatch is repaired
authoritativeAlgorithm: remove ONLY filterChecks and activeRejectionReasons from every Brand candidate
canonicalize that complete FieldSelection with issue-149-candidate-canonical-v1
canonicalize debug.finalSelections.brand with the same algorithm
require EXACT string equality of the two canonical forms
parityAssertion.comparedFieldsNote: The list below is EXPLANATORY ONLY and is not authoritative. Full-object canonical equality is the invariant, so brandDiagnostics.lines, every candidate property, all observation and provenance fields, and ANY future enumerable field added to FieldSelection are compared automatically.
explicitlyIncludes: any future enumerable field on FieldSelection
parityAssertion.priorDefect: Amendment 2 made a 21-field allowlist authoritative. It omitted brandDiagnostics.lines, and a future field could have escaped comparison silently.

candidateEvidenceSource.why: only the diagnostic selection carries filterChecks and activeRejectionReasons; parity proves the two are otherwise the same array

costOfTheSecondCall.note: selectBrandObservationWithCompleteFilterDiagnostics is a pure re-selection over pass results already produced. It runs no OCR and reads no image.

mustProve: a synthetic pass set where primary Brand is OBSERVED compares only [passes[0]]
a synthetic pass set where primary Brand is not OBSERVED compares the complete pass array
canonical equality holds once the two diagnostic fields are removed
an injected difference in brandDiagnostics.lines is detected
an injected difference in a candidate property is detected
an injected difference in an observation field is detected
stage2TestContract.implementedNote: Amendment 10 added and ran these tests; the contract still said they were not implemented. Amendment 11 corrects that and adds the ranked-invariant tests that reach past parity.
